summary: The source supports three bounded byte-string fields and three int32 CURSIM slots, with next-line string payloads but same-line CURSIM values. String EOF preserves the previous value; CURSIM zeroes all slots even on failure. Changed dimension resets these fields, while same dimension and later recognized headers do not. The current importer can add four category1 handlers without changing its public loading method, but shared-model edits require separate authorization.

contracts.subject: storage and defaults
contracts.distinction: TITLE is not console problem ID at root+0x340. Native offsets are evidence anchors, not a requested C++ binary layout.

contracts.subject: string framing and mutation
steps: After scanner consumes keyword, first fgets(max1024) discards remaining keyword-line bytes.
Second fgets(max1024) supplies payload, including keyword-looking text or an empty line.
Failure of either read returns1 before any destination write.
Success removes first LF, copies capacity-1 bytes with strncpy semantics, scans that bounded destination backward past NUL/space/LF/CR, then writes terminator.
Leading whitespace and trailing tab survive; trim occurs after truncation. Successful blank payload overwrites with empty string. Nonempty final partial line succeeds.
contracts.status: Helper0->handler0;helper1->handler2. Prior string retained only on read failure, not on successful blank input.
contracts.bounds: ASCII, no embedded NUL, initialized prior strings. For the approved fixture domain, each translated line including LF fits in1023 bytes; keyword-line remainder must fit too. Longer reads may leave fragments and are not covered here.

contracts.subject: CURSIM parse and partial assignments
steps: Zero three live destinations before reading.
Read one fgets line starting at scanner cursor: CURSIM's remainder, not the next physical line.
Replace commas with spaces; scan %i %i %i. Caller passes null optional conversion-count pointer, established by retained assembly.
EOF/no line and scanf EOF(-1), including whitespace-only remainder, return helper1 after zeroing.
Matching failure0 and partial counts1/2 succeed, retaining converted prefix and zero suffix; count3 succeeds.
contracts.status: Map helper0 to0, other helper status to2. Do not require exactly3 conversions or commit only on success.
contracts.bounds: Signed32 representable ordinary numeric inputs; overflow and malformed prefix/sign CRT behavior remain excluded.

contracts.subject: header and reset lifecycle
rules: Asterisk-leading token triggers one bounded line read; only the first recognized dimension header in one import is applied.
Earlier ordinary comments do not consume the first-recognized-header opportunity.
Changed dimension calls clear plus root initialization, which resets metadata through1e7c50->1e7e90. Same dimension is a no-op.
First recognized header also applies complementary dimension to the linked root if present. Later headers in that import cannot reset either root.
Malformed incomplete DEFORM header is not assigned deterministic native behavior; replacement's explicit unsupported result should remain.

contracts.subject: parser continuation and unknown tokens
rules: Lookup is case-sensitive. Unknown token causes current-line remainder skip and warning except SRFNRG suppression.
A string payload is not rescanned as a keyword.
Handler2 logs reading error and scanning continues. Later successful handlers do not erase accumulated status2; EOF returns it.
Recognized but unimplemented entries remain an explicit replacement limitation. Do not convert them to unknown/ignored entries.

implementation_fit.assessment: Small source change is feasible after separate implementation authorization; no public loading-signature change is required.
implementation_fit.model_option: Add explicit byte-string metadata and array<int32_t,3> to SimulationControls with M1 defaults; expose narrow ObjectModel mutation methods. initialized_root_controls constructs SimulationControls, and set_dimension already replaces controls only when dimension changes. This fits the existing optional reset-profile model. Do not add scientific interpretations or rename problem ID into TITLE.
implementation_fit.missing_profile_policy: Current category1 handler rejects missing controls.simulation. Keep this explicit unsupported boundary unless a broader model contract is separately authorized. Do not silently fabricate full simulation controls just to accept metadata.
handler_plan: TITLE/SIMNAM: reader.name(previous); OPRNAM: reader.material_name(previous). Preserve previous field on either failed read. Keep capacities by keyword.
CURSIM: reader.integer_triple(); store all three values even when helper fails. Map helper status to0/2 without exact-conversion-count validation.
Preserve import_translated(std::string_view,bool), catalog loading, event observer, sticky errors, unknown-token skip and requested finalization behavior.
implementation_fit.api: Existing loader API can remain source-compatible. The metadata-only harness can use import_translated(bytes,false) to inspect parser/handler behavior without claiming wrapper finalization; any requested-finalization tests are separate.
implementation_fit.abi: Adding members to public C++ structs changes layout and can require rebuilding consumers. No binary ABI compatibility with old libraries or original DEFORM is proved or promised. Native addresses and capacities specify behavior, not reconstruction offsets.
